stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.11 — Roux Block-internal Orientation Quotient, Frame-preserving Phase Geometry & Method-specific Null Foundry

clarifications.cmll_consistency: For an admitted locked frame, at a nonempty ROUX_CMLL endpoint both standard 1x2x3 blocks must be exactly solved and all eight corner cubies must equal the solved-corner configuration under at least one of the four U-face AUF variants {I,U,U2,U'}. This is not comparison of the endpoint to itself.
clarifications.cmll_objective_geometry: Within the CMLL line, objective distance is all-corner full piece+orientation distance to the annotated CMLL endpoint, minimized over the endpoint's four U-face AUF variants. This is a trajectory geometry definition and is separate from the solved-corner consistency gate.
clarifications.objective_backtrack_amplitude: For distances d_0,...,d_T within one phase, amplitude=max_t[d_t-min_{0<=j<=t} d_j], with a floor at zero. Thus only worsening after previously achieved progress contributes.
clarifications.anchor_break_amplitude: For an anchor mask expected solved at phase entry, compute coordinate mismatch fraction a_t in the locked frame and amplitude=max_t max(0,a_t-a_0).
clarifications.geometry_failure_denominator: Eligible phase opportunities are nonempty annotated FB/SB/CMLL/LSE lines in unique-frame state-certified attempts; failures are opportunities whose frozen mask/endpoint geometry cannot be evaluated. Missing phase annotations are reported separately and are not silently converted into zero-amplitude features.
clarifications.one_percent_resolution: For a genuinely fresh attempt compared against a frozen historical familywise attempt bank of size n, add-one p_min=1/(n+1). Primary 1% authority therefore requires n>=99 on every conditioning path that could be used for the primary claim.
